name: Hannah Kowalski
source:
Hannah Kowalski works at the Rackham City library. Her twin sister works at the City Hall library. Does their mother work at a library? No one knows. The two sisters were left at the Rackham orphanage at 5 months old. Hannah, being the older twin by 15 minutes, took it upon herself to protect her sister from all that comes with growing up without the natural safety net of a family. Hannah as a tendency to be hard on her sister, but would sacrifice all for [url=/c176698]Grace[/url].

[Edited from in-game description]
